text:
sam: quick ping — small PR #4827 wants to land before Friday config-freeze. CI keeps failing with runner rate-limit errors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/4827 :pray:
tess: which job is failing? can you paste the error output so I can triage
sam: paste from CI:
```
ERROR: Runner lease failed: rate limit exceeded (10/min)
failed to claim runner: no available runners in pool \"e2e-large\"
```
sam: it stumbles around the 3rd matrix job (mac/linux x py38/py39) — looks like parallel jobs spike the lease usage
nisha: ok. i can kick caches and request a rerun but might be simpler to trim the matrix for this landing. can you reduce to linux/py39 for now?
sam: yeah i can push a reduced matrix branch and rebase on main now
sam: also FYI the release calendar shows a rebase/merge window Thu 22:00 UTC and a config-freeze Fri 00:00 UTC — want to avoid Friday blackout
leo: i'll give manual eyes and +1 once CI is green. @tess can you do a quick review of the test timeout tweak?
tess: taking a look now, should be quick
devbot: @sam requested a CI rerun for PR 4827 (job id 98321)
ci-bot: rerun queued on e2e pool, ETA ~4m (rate-limit throttle applied)
tess: small comment in test: drop the flaky assert and use assert in_range -> LGTM after that change
sam: pushed reduced matrix and removed flaky assert. thanks :thumbsup:
nisha: rerun kicked, monitoring. if it still hits rate-limit i'll ping eng-infra to bump temporary capacity for the e2e pool
leo: plan: if green, we land Thu 20:00 UTC (two hours before rebase window) to avoid any last-minute deploy freeze impact
tess: approved. +1
sam: tagging the merge window now — manual-merge Thu 20:00 UTC. will rebase 30m before and post final status
nisha: noted, will stand by for capacity burst if needed
sam: thanks everyone — will update this thread after the merge
